label: M1_mode7_low_rtp
_note: Mode 7 = low-RTP mode (~80% RTP). Mode 1's 'turbulent' counterpart.
v1: RTP ~80%. Cut hit + low-multiplier wins from mode 1. Preserve mid/high.
v2 follow-up: 'mode 7 的中奖率砍半太过分了, 砍到 10% 差不多' — hit rate 7.8% was too aggressive, aim for ~10%.

Math: mode 1 is 94.3% RTP / 15.5% hit. To land at ~10% hit / ~82% RTP, we ease back Cherry + mixed-Bar (which were cut too far in v1) while still keeping them below mode 1's levels. Mid/high absolute pp stays preserved.
ge1_lt5 (Cherry):              5.0%   → 5.50pp  (6.8% of RTP)   ← bumped from v1's 3.0%
Low (1-10×):       13.0pp (15.7%)  — Cherry eased back to 5% hit (mode 1 had 10%)
Mid (10-50×):      55.0pp (66.3%)  — preserved in absolute pp (mode 1 had 59pp)

Player feel: hit rate ~10% means players see a win every ~10 spins (mode 1 is every ~6.5 spins, v1 was every ~13). Still noticeably more 'grindy' than mode 1 but not punishing — cherry still fires at a reasonable base-line cadence. Mid/high wins identical in frequency to mode 1, giving mode 7 its distinct 'less small wins, same big-win dynamics' signature.
CV projected ~ 5.9 (between mode 1's 5.06 and v1's 6.31). Volatility preserved relative to mode 1 but not as extreme as v1.
Strips are SHARED with mode 1/2/5 (file layout invariant). Only weights differ.
